psa_sdg_16_1_1.notes: Rates as published (PSA computes them). Indicator label carries footnote '1/' whose text was not returned by the API. Negros Island Region row is empty for all years, so Regions VI and VII include the Negros provinces, matching the 2020 geoBoundaries regions. BARMM matched to the geoBoundaries 'ARMM' shape (2020 layer; BARMM's territory differs slightly: Cotabato City added 2019, Sulu removed 2024).

problems: psa.gov.ph, rsso*.psa.gov.ph and pnp.gov.ph return HTTP 403 to this environment, so PSA regional PDFs with provincial crime volumes (murder/homicide by province) could not be downloaded. Only the OpenSTAT PXWeb API was reachable.
